name: Johan Danielsson - § 8/1
title: REPORT on addressing subcontracting chains and the role of intermediaries in order to protect workers’ rights
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘calls on the Commission to include relevant proposals favouring direct employment relationships in its upcoming quality jobs act;’
part_context: Calls on the Commission and the Member States to address illegal practices in subcontracting chains in order to ensure business competitiveness and fair and safe working conditions; encourages, in this context, direct employment relationships in high-risk sectors, where feasible, justified, proportionate and based on overriding reasons of public interest, such as the protection of workers and their rights; <del>calls on the Commission to include relevant proposals favouring direct employment relationships in its upcoming quality jobs act;</del>
